procurement.description: 按发票检查逾期、重复编号、采购订单/收货/发票金额偏差；币种分开汇总。

service.description: 已解决工单按解决时刻核算，未解决工单按当前 UTC 核算。用户显式提供 SLA。

energy.description: 比较同一记录提供的基准 kWh；废弃物回收率基于用户提供重量。没有基准时不推断节能。

provenance.title: UCI Online Retail
provenance.citation: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail. UCI. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5BW33.
provenance.population: Invoice lines of one UK-based non-store gifts retailer; 2010–2011

leakage_controls: Fixed-origin 28-day holdout; no test sales enter forecasts.
Method chosen using a separate earlier 28-day validation interval.
SKU ranking uses training sales only.
Last possibly partial source day excluded.

recommendation.title: Use sales history as the first replenishment input
recommendation.detail: Calibrate the selected demand baseline on your own recent sales; add stock on hand, lead time and service-level targets before computing replenishment quantities.

limitations: Sales are a demand proxy. Stock availability, lost sales, replenishment lead time and fulfillment are not recorded.
This 2010–2011 retailer benchmark is not current business telemetry.
Returns/cancellations and non-positive-price/quantity rows are excluded from positive sales; missing CustomerID does not exclude an otherwise valid sale.
InvoiceDate has no explicit source timezone; aggregation preserves the source calendar date.
The last source day is excluded from evaluation because it may be partial.
The five training-selected SKU holdouts have WAPE 89.6%, 151.3%, 90.1%, 68.9%, 68.1%. Aggregate accuracy does not establish reliable SKU replenishment.

findings.title: Demand forecast heldout comparison
findings.detail: Fixed-origin holdout WAPE: 23.0%; seasonal-naive comparison: 25.7%. Positive invoice sales are a demand proxy. Stockout and fulfillment risks require stock and lead-time inputs.
findings.recommended_action: Review the heldout chart, then add stock on hand and lead time before using replenishment scenarios.

forecast_scope.label: 14-day scenario after the historical log; not the heldout evaluated window

provenance.title: BPI Challenge 2019
provenance.population: Anonymized purchase-order line-item event log of a multinational coatings/paints company; POs submitted in 2018
provenance.selection: Full compressed XES parsed; invoice-lag model uses unambiguous subset only.

baseline.method: pre-cutoff median invoice-to-clear duration by item category; global-median fallback
leakage_controls: Training clear events must occur before 2018-10-01.
Heldout invoice receipt timestamps are on/after cutoff.
Purchase documents observed in training are excluded from test.
Only item category known at invoice receipt is a model input; later events and amounts are not inputs.
Unambiguous one invoice/one clear cases only; no guessed invoice matching.
baseline.interpretation: Weak predictive utility. The improvement over the global-median comparator is small; no meaningful operational improvement is established.

recommendation.title: Investigate receipt-to-clear delays by item category
recommendation.detail: Compare long-running invoices against the pre-cutoff category baseline and inspect the exact source events. Add invoice/receipt identifiers before investigating multi-invoice cases.

limitations: PO and invoice approval workflows are absent. SRM labels do not establish actual approval waiting time.
Amounts are anonymized transformations, even where source fields say EUR; no real monetary savings are computed.
Multiple goods receipts/invoices/clears are not automatically paired. Invoice-to-clear baseline uses only unambiguous one-invoice/one-clear cases without cancellations.
Clear Invoice is a payment-clearing event, not a bank settlement timestamp.
Completed-case duration metrics are subject to censoring and are descriptive, not causal evidence that an intervention will help.
Weak predictive utility. The improvement over the global-median comparator is small; no meaningful operational improvement is established.

Raw trace timestamp anomalies span 1948–2020, despite the declared 2018 purchase-order cohort. Invoice/clear timestamps used in this baseline are in 2018–2019; source anomalies remain visible, not silently rewritten.

findings.title: Heldout prefix duration reference
findings.detail: Case 4508055157_00010: at 2018-10-01T06:16:00+00:00, the pre-cutoff baseline predicts 1007.3 hours from invoice receipt to clearing. Only the observed prefix and known category/activity ID enter this prediction. Eventual outcome is in the separate replay. Weak predictive utility. The improvement over the global-median comparator is small; no meaningful operational improvement is established.
findings.recommended_action: Inspect this prefix, optionally reveal its eventual outcome, and supply your own escalation/SLA threshold before flagging a breach.

confidence.interpretation: Weak predictive utility. The improvement over the global-median comparator is small; no meaningful operational improvement is established.

provenance.license_basis: Canonical Mendeley Helpdesk v1 MIT license; same contributor-maintained public dataset alternative

period.timezone: Source timestamps have no timezone; a uniform UTC offset is used only for elapsed-time arithmetic, not geographic alignment

baseline.method: pre-cutoff median remaining duration conditional on anonymized last activity ID
baseline.evaluation_cohort: Completed heldout cases with at least three recorded events; second-event prefix followed by an eventual event, not all incoming tickets
leakage_controls: Cutoff chosen by case-start timestamps, not outcome labels.
All training cases must complete strictly before cutoff.
All heldout cases start on/after cutoff; case IDs remain disjoint.
Test input is only the observed two-event prefix. Completion time is used only for scoring.
Activity codes are retained without fabricated stage meanings.
baseline.interpretation: Weak predictive utility. This activity-conditioned baseline is worse than the global-median comparator on the heldout set; no meaningful improvement is established.

recommendation.title: Use case age and observed event prefixes for triage
recommendation.detail: Evaluate on your own resolution history and an explicit SLA/business-hours definition before setting alerts. This baseline predicts remaining duration, without claiming any SLA breach.

limitations: Historical closed-case benchmark, not the user’s current helpdesk.
Activity IDs are anonymized. No activity names or support-stage meanings are invented.
No contractual SLA, priority, business-hours calendar or staffing capacity is supplied. SLA calculations require an explicit scenario threshold.
The heldout remaining-time evaluation covers completed cases with at least three events (a nonterminal two-event prefix), not all incoming tickets.
Completion-only evaluation can under-represent unresolved/long-running cases. Temporal training excludes cases whose completion was not yet observable.
Weak predictive utility. This activity-conditioned baseline is worse than the global-median comparator on the heldout set; no meaningful improvement is established.

findings.title: Heldout prefix duration reference
findings.detail: Case 4466: at 2012-05-11T20:14:20+00:00, the pre-cutoff baseline predicts 170.1 hours remaining until completion. Only the observed prefix and known category/activity ID enter this prediction. Eventual outcome is in the separate replay. Weak predictive utility. This activity-conditioned baseline is worse than the global-median comparator on the heldout set; no meaningful improvement is established.
findings.recommended_action: Inspect this prefix, optionally reveal its eventual outcome, and supply your own escalation/SLA threshold before flagging a breach.

confidence.interpretation: Weak predictive utility. This activity-conditioned baseline is worse than the global-median comparator on the heldout set; no meaningful improvement is established.

experiments.interpretation: One bounded training-validation-only experiment. No meaningful operational improvement is established; substantial heldout errors and completed-case bias remain.
experiments.selection_rule: Minimum validation MAE; final test never selects or adjusts method/bins/minimum group size.
leakage_controls: Training cases finish before each training origin.
Validation cases start after the inner cutoff and finish before the final training origin.
Final test cases start after the final training origin.
Whole case remains in one partition; only observed second-event activity and elapsed age are features.
Age bins and minimum group size of 20 fixed before final test.

provenance.population: Great Britain electricity generation carbon intensity, 30-minute periods; actual values are estimates

baseline.method: contiguous forecast-only window minimization versus earliest feasible start
baseline.reason: No verified historical forecast issue vintages; cannot run leakage-free prospective heldout forecast evaluation.
leakage_controls: Exclude any interval already started at forecast retrieval.
Use forecast values only; estimated actual never selects the schedule.
Validate contiguous coverage and explicit duration constraints.

scenario_comparison.basis: Forecast-only scenario from one saved snapshot; not realized savings.

recommendation.title: Schedule a flexible one-hour load in the lowest forecast window
recommendation.detail: Saved-snapshot scenario: 2026-10-09T12:30:00+00:00 to 2026-10-09T13:30:00+00:00. Refresh the forecast before scheduling and supply actual task kWh and constraints.

limitations: Great Britain only. The API actual value is an estimated carbon intensity, not a direct emissions measurement.
Generation-related CO2 only; no tariffs, electricity consumption, materials waste or measured waste reductions are supplied.
Historical forecast issue vintages are not established, so retrospective forecast accuracy or realized scheduling savings are not claimed.
A saved forecast snapshot supports prospective scenario scheduling only while it is fresh and covers the requested window.
User task kWh and scheduling constraints are required for task-specific emissions.

findings.title: Schedule a flexible one-hour load in the lowest forecast window
findings.detail: Saved-snapshot scenario: 2026-10-09T12:30:00+00:00 to 2026-10-09T13:30:00+00:00. Refresh the forecast before scheduling and supply actual task kWh and constraints. Forecast-only reduction versus earliest feasible start: 91.0 gCO2 per 1 kWh scenario. This is not realized savings.
findings.recommended_action: Refresh the snapshot and specify task kWh, duration and deadline before acting.

schedule.basis: Forecast-only scenario from one saved snapshot; not realized savings.

documents.title: UCI Online Retail
documents.text: Independent public supply benchmark. Positive sales lines: 530104 lines; Heldout forecast WAPE: 0.230229 ratio; Next 14 days forecast sales: 351144.5 units. Training cutoff: 2011-11-10; heldout interval: 2011-11-11 to 2011-12-08. Baseline: weekday_mean_4w. Calibrate the selected demand baseline on your own recent sales; add stock on hand, lead time and service-level targets before computing replenishment quantities. Sales are a demand proxy. Stock availability, lost sales, replenishment lead time and fulfillment are not recorded. This 2010–2011 retailer benchmark is not current business telemetry. Returns/cancellations and non-positive-price/quantity rows are excluded from positive sales; missing CustomerID does not exclude an otherwise valid sale. InvoiceDate has no explicit source timezone; aggregation preserves the source calendar date. The last source day is excluded from evaluation because it may be partial. The five training-selected SKU holdouts have WAPE 89.6%, 151.3%, 90.1%, 68.9%, 68.1%. Aggregate accuracy does not establish reliable SKU replenishment.

documents.title: BPI Challenge 2019
documents.text: Independent public procurement benchmark. Purchase-item cases: 251734 cases; Source events: 1595923 events; Unambiguous invoice/clear cases: 171739 cases; Heldout invoice-clear duration MAE: 453.1368 hours. Training cutoff: 2018-10-01T00:00:00+00:00; heldout interval: 2018-10-01T00:00:00+00:00 to 2019-01-18T13:31:00+00:00. Baseline: pre-cutoff median invoice-to-clear duration by item category; global-median fallback. Compare long-running invoices against the pre-cutoff category baseline and inspect the exact source events. Add invoice/receipt identifiers before investigating multi-invoice cases. PO and invoice approval workflows are absent. SRM labels do not establish actual approval waiting time. Amounts are anonymized transformations, even where source fields say EUR; no real monetary savings are computed. Multiple goods receipts/invoices/clears are not automatically paired. Invoice-to-clear baseline uses only unambiguous one-invoice/one-clear cases without cancellations. Clear Invoice is a payment-clearing event, not a bank settlement timestamp. Completed-case duration metrics are subject to censoring and are descriptive, not causal evidence that an intervention will help. Weak predictive utility. The improvement over the global-median comparator is small; no meaningful operational improvement is established. Raw trace timestamp anomalies span 1948–2020, despite the declared 2018 purchase-order cohort. Invoice/clear timestamps used in this baseline are in 2018–2019; source anomalies remain visible, not silently rewritten.

documents.title: Mendeley Helpdesk v1
documents.text: Independent public service benchmark. Historical cases: 3804 cases; Source events: 13710 events; Median case duration: 94.267 hours; Heldout remaining-duration MAE: 145.1021 hours. Training cutoff: 2012-04-12T22:57:38+00:00; heldout interval: 2012-04-12T22:57:38+00:00 to 2012-11-06T01:41:28+00:00. Baseline: pre-cutoff median remaining duration conditional on anonymized last activity ID. Evaluate on your own resolution history and an explicit SLA/business-hours definition before setting alerts. This baseline predicts remaining duration, without claiming any SLA breach. Historical closed-case benchmark, not the user’s current helpdesk. Activity IDs are anonymized. No activity names or support-stage meanings are invented. No contractual SLA, priority, business-hours calendar or staffing capacity is supplied. SLA calculations require an explicit scenario threshold. The heldout remaining-time evaluation covers completed cases with at least three events (a nonterminal two-event prefix), not all incoming tickets. Completion-only evaluation can under-represent unresolved/long-running cases. Temporal training excludes cases whose completion was not yet observable. Weak predictive utility. This activity-conditioned baseline is worse than the global-median comparator on the heldout set; no meaningful improvement is established. Bounded age-conditioned experiment selected on earlier validation only: heldout MAE142.751 hours vs global145.0073 hours. Improvement remains small and predictive utility weak.
